verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Square serves an llms.txt index at developer.squareup.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). A companion llms-full.txt with full doc content is also published, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: markdown variants of doc pages (docs.md returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these files effectively.
